description.value: Lemongrass is a Vietnamese restaurant in Kamloops serving creative Asian fusion cuisine made from scratch with fresh, sustainably sourced ingredients. The menu spans pho, spring rolls, vermicelli, stir fries, and Japanese-influenced items like gyoza and tempura, all prepared to order. It has earned a loyal local following and offers a comfortable sit-down dining experience for cyclists needing a proper meal stop.
